documents.topic: Ecosystem inventory of 952 `__unchecked:` call sites across swift-primitives. Classifies each against the Tagged brief's five categories (legitimate-bypass / could-use-validated-init / missing-validated-init / test-fixture / other) and separates structurally-distinct sibling conventions (Tagged 2-param, Tagged 1-param extension, Finite.Enumerable labelled-ordinal, non-Tagged struct inits like Time/Instant/Binary.Cursor, method APIs like Hash.Table.insert/Ownership.Slot.take/Input.Restore.to). Surfaces taxonomy tensions: `missing-validated-init` conflates API gaps with deliberate no-invariant phantom aliases (Radian, Index<T>); `could-use-validated-init` conflates oversight with pre-verified fast-path. Feeds later remediation discussion; makes no decisions.

Decompose swift-rendering-primitives into three sibling L1 packages: swift-render-primitives (domain-neutral infra), swift-render-markup-primitives (SGML-family document vocabulary), swift-render-image-primitives (PostScript-imaging-model graphics vocabulary). Dependency-delta criterion justifies package-split over target-split (image vocabulary needs geometry + affine deps). Executes as Phase 1 of HANDOFF-package-noun-rename.md.

Tier 2: Ecosystem-wide nextSpan pattern audit (97 iterators, 7 patterns). Optional<T> as inline MaybeUninit eliminates ALL 32 heap-allocating iterators to 0. Subsumes nextspan-delegation-reduction.

Pool.Bounded storage refactor (Tier 1) — two parallel fixed-capacity arrays (slots + entries) subscripted by Slot.Index with .rawValue at 30+ call sites. Investigation of replacing stdlib Array subscripts with typed index access. Migrated from swift-institute per [META-017].

narrativeSections.heading: Scope
narrativeSections.body:
This directory contains primitives-wide research—design analysis that affects multiple primitives packages but is specific to the primitives layer.

For ecosystem-wide research, see: `swift-institute/Research/`

For package-specific research, see: `{package}/Research/`
